_help: Where the scraper looks for shows, and how the site renders them.
This file is meant to be edited by hand. Nothing else needs touching to add a venue.
ADDING A TARGET
1. Open any event of that account on Dinaticket. The URL looks like
dinaticket.com/es/provider/20073/event/4951866
2. The first number (20073) is the provider. That is what you need.
3. Copy one of the lines below, change the number and the name.
THE THREE TYPES
own    The provider is the artist's own account. Everything in it is theirs,
so it is NOT filtered by name. Many events leave the Artist field empty,
and filtering here could wipe the artist's own shows.
venue  The provider is a theatre that programmes many artists. Every event is
read, and only the ones whose Artist field matches artist.aliases stay.
event  A single event, without listing the provider. Needs provider AND event.
To disable a target without deleting it, set "active": false.
IF A SHOW DOES NOT APPEAR (venue targets only)
The venue almost always spelled the artist differently. At the end of each run
the scraper lists rejected events whose artist contains artist.surname. Add
that spelling to artist.aliases. Aliases are compared without accents, case
or punctuation, so 'Fernández' and 'fernandez' are the same alias.
